connector.name: Trackly CLI by trackly-app
connector.registryDescription: AI job search for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor. 128K+ jobs, 1,900+ companies. OAuth or stdio.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.usetrackly.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package trackly-cli. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the trackly-app account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer trk_* API key for remote clients that don't support OAuth 2.1 Dynamic Client Registration. Clients that do support DCR can leave this blank — the server will guide them through an interactive OAuth flow. Create an API key at https://usetrackly.app/settings
